relations.statement: Decision(E0(J) < threshold) for 3D +-J Ising spin glass reduces in polynomial time to estimating thermal energy <H>_beta of H = -sum J_ij sigma^x_i sigma^x_j to additive precision, at beta J >= N ln 2 + ln(12N).
relations.hypotheses: Barahona NP-completeness of 3D +-J Ising ground-state decision; Troyer-Wiese PRL 94 170201 eqs (10)-(11) and footnote 9; precision promise on the estimator; imported assumption, not formalized here.

relations.statement: A deterministic polynomial-time estimator for the family gives P = NP; a randomized one gives NP subset of BPP.
relations.hypotheses: R1_reduction_chain and the estimator meeting the precision promise on all instances of the family.

lemmas.statement: Imported assumption: the Troyer-Wiese reduction from 3D +-J Ising ground-energy threshold decision to thermal energy estimation at beta J >= N ln 2 + ln(12N) is polynomial time.

near_misses.claim: The result implies intractability of the Hubbard model or of every fermionic Hamiltonian.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The statement is a worst-case result about the frustrated sigma^x Ising family under a precision promise; it is not a reduction to the Hubbard model.

near_misses.claim: The result makes any fixed finite system intractable.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Hardness is asymptotic in N and worst-case over instances; a fixed finite system is solvable in constant time.
